verdict.rationale: Notte documents serverless Functions that can be invoked as API endpoints or scheduled. That covers on-demand invocation and time-based recurrence, not user-defined rules that fire actions automatically when events occur. Nothing in the pack shows a rules engine, event triggers, or conditional automation, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
